paragraphs: Rav Ukva bar Chinena of Perishna.
Mentioned in [Pesachim 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.91a.15): he posed a contradiction to Rava.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli gives Rav Ukva bar Chinena of Perishna posing a contradiction to Rava about the Passover offering.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2870&lang=en) suggests a possible identification with Rav Ika son of Rav Chinena of Pashrunya. Hyman’s notice gives only Ukva.
